title: Murmuring Moray Moppet
statement: A shy, ribbon-like eel who lives in a teapot-shaped ceramic cave, peeking out to hum tiny bubbles that pop into soft, fizzing melodies. Its tank is a dim amber twilight of driftwood arches and slow swaying vallisneria, where the only light comes from a single warm bulb above — the eel prefers it that way, and so do you.
